messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to all the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Monday, Thursday, Friday, or is observed on a Monday/Friday when the actual holiday lands on a weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday; observed on Monday. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Alberta, BC, Manitoba, Ontario, Saskatchewan) | Family Day was on Monday, Feb 20. |
| **Mar 17–19** | St. Patrick’s Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | St. Patrick’s Day was on Friday, Mar 17. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is always on Friday. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day was on Monday, May 22. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Mon Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday; observed on Monday. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Labour Day was on Monday, Sep 4. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving was on Monday, Oct 9. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Mon Nov 13) | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday; observed on Monday. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day | Christmas Day was on Monday, Dec 25. |

> **Total long weekends:** 10 (including the provincial St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador).

These are the federal holidays that created three‑day weekends in 2023. If you need provincial holidays that also create long weekends (e.g., “St. Patricks’ Day” in other provinces, “St. John’s Day” in Prince Edward Island, etc.), let me know and I can add those as well.
